Oneliner

Detects marine waste from Jeju and the southern coast.
Description

Detects marine waste from Jeju and the southern coast. It observes how marine waste moves according to the ocean currents, and satellite operation data obtained in this process will be used for future satellite development. Aim to verify the performance of the modules used in this satellite and standardize the Cube satellite platform in the future.
Results

All 12 Nuri-deployed cube satellites establish ground communication, 2025-12-08.
